cohort: 70 American Society of Anesthesiologists I and II parturients with no comorbidities admitted for elective Cesarean section.
finding: The addition of dexmedetomidine to bupivacaine in a transversus abdominis plane (TAP) block significantly prolonged the duration of analgesia and reduced opioid requirement in the first 24 hours after Cesarean section compared to bupivacaine alone.
